title: Voxel Rooftop Greenhouse
tests: Generated with openclaw infer image generate using openai/gpt-image-2; exact PNG output verified before append.
prompt:
Render a rooftop greenhouse maintenance scene as richly detailed voxel graphics: a compact city roof garden built from crisp cube geometry, translucent glass panels, stepped planters of herbs and dwarf citrus, blocky irrigation tubes, tiny fans, water barrels, seedling trays, and a repair cart with square tools. Use a warm late-afternoon sky, strong readable silhouettes, tactile pixel-cube shadows, varied greens, terracotta, clear aqua glass, and small lived-in details. The image is a finished visual example only: no captions, no labels, no prompt-card text, no logos, no watermarks, no cinematic movie scene.

Reusable template: Render [SUBJECT] as a richly detailed [STYLE_OR_MEDIUM] image with tactile format-specific marks, clear subject silhouette, environmental context, and no prompt-card text.

Operation: changes the subject into a finished style/medium showcase where the medium controls geometry, texture, lighting, and surface detail rather than acting like a light filter.

Negative constraints: no readable private data, no logos, no watermarks, no prompt cards, no incoherent anatomy, no generic centered product photo.

Example substitution: Render a neighborhood rooftop greenhouse maintenance scene as richly detailed voxel graphics.

randomRenderingStyle.description: A rooftop greenhouse maintenance scene rebuilt as tactile cube-based voxel art.
